item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. You've stacked wind-down cues tonight — relaxation, a check-in, and an early bedtime. That's the right shape, but it only works if you start it on time instead of letting the day's last task bleed into it. Protect the transition: when the wind-down block hits, stop and actually shift gears. Action: set an alarm for your bedtime prep and honor it.
